summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Castellan Targeted Income ETF (CTIF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund invests in US-listed dividend-paying companies combined with a covered call overlay. The actively managed ETF uses a proprietary methodology that blends both quantitative and qualitative analysis. CTIF was launched on Jun 25, 2025 and is issued by Castellan.

holdings.infoBox: CTIF is an equity ETF with a total of 46 individual holdings. The top holdings are Parker-Hannifin stock at 6.03%, W.W. Grainger at 5.41%, Microsoft at 5.30%, Eaton Corporation at 5.09%, and Automatic Data Processing at 4.94%.
